# NodeRoom
> NodeRoom is a live collaborative AI room where humans and NodeAgents work together across shared files, spreadsheets, notes, and source-backed trace receipts.

## Official pages
- [NodeRoom home](https://noderoom.live/): Primary product landing page.
- [What is NodeRoom?](https://noderoom.live/brand/noderoom/): Official brand and entity disambiguation page.
- [Solutions](https://noderoom.live/solutions/): Search-intent hub for collaborative AI rooms.
- [Collaborative AI workspace](https://noderoom.live/solutions/collaborative-ai-workspace/): Shared workspace for people and AI agents.
- [AI agent collaboration](https://noderoom.live/solutions/ai-agent-collaboration/): NodeAgent coordination and visible room state.
- [Source-backed AI workflows](https://noderoom.live/solutions/source-backed-ai-workflows/): Cited changes, traces, and reviewable receipts.
- [AI diligence room](https://noderoom.live/solutions/ai-diligence-room/): Evidence-backed diligence and review workflows.
- [AI research workspace](https://noderoom.live/solutions/ai-research-workspace/): Research sources, notes, tables, and artifacts in one room.
- [Use cases](https://noderoom.live/use-cases/): Startup diligence, sales research, finance workflows, and student projects.
- [Learn](https://noderoom.live/learn/): How collaborative AI rooms work.
- [FAQ](https://noderoom.live/faq/): Product, privacy, indexing, and workflow questions.

## Key facts
- NodeRoom is the official product name.
- NodeAgents are AI agents that work inside NodeRoom rooms.
- Public marketing and education pages are crawlable.
- Live room, demo, create, and scoped app URLs should remain noindex.
- NodeRoom is a workflow and evaluation surface, not financial, legal, lending, or insurance advice.

## Preferred descriptions
- Short: NodeRoom is a collaborative AI room for source-backed work.
- Medium: NodeRoom gives teams a live room where people and NodeAgents collaborate across files, spreadsheets, notes, and traceable source-backed changes.
